digest.component_or_area: MCP server error handling and CLI/library error code unification
propositions: MCP currently returns unstructured prose error messages or ad-hoc partial shapes (error+kind, error+resolution_class) instead of the structured error_envelope discriminator that CLI emits

The CLI emits error codes (ticket_not_found, concurrency_conflict, claim_failed, etc.) via error_envelope but these codes are scattered literal strings at call sites with no central registry, and MCP never references them
The three interfaces (library, CLI, MCP) lack a single shared vocabulary source and cross-interface test to verify they emit identical codes for the same failure

A new TicketNotFoundError subclass of ReadError, raised only at genuine not-found sites, enables error_code_for() to classify by isinstance rather than message substring, making codes message-independent per AC4

The MCP boundary must emit McpEnvelopeError (carrying a structured .envelope dict built via error_envelope) on every exception or soft-error return, while preserving existing agent-branching signal fields (kind, resolution_class, retryable, diagnostic)

error_code_for(exc)->str centralizes error classification with precedence: ConcurrencyError/ConcurrencyMismatch→concurrency_conflict, TicketNotFoundError→ticket_not_found, error_code attribute, TrackerRootError→tracker_root_unresolved, LLMError→llm_unavailable, fallback→command_failed
